p.PROJECT-FOLLOWS-THE-REDBOOK: This project follows the **redbook** — a collection of AI-native development practices, each installed as its own flow with its own boot snippet and protocol documents.

p.THIS-SNIPPET-ONLY-NAMES-THE-COLLECTION: This snippet only names the collection; the members carry the actual rules.

p.practices-distilled-from-the-book: The practices are distilled from the book *AI-native development*.

p.THE-BOOK-SHIPS-IN-THIS-PACKAGE: The book itself ships in this package at `spec/book/ru/` (currently in Russian — see `spec/book/README.md` for the edition plan).

p.spirit-of-the-process-lead: **The general spirit of the process comes from the book**:

facts.SPIRIT-FILES-AS-THE-ONLY-SHARED-MEMORY: files as the only shared memory,

p.DO-NOT-READ-THE-BOOK-AT-SESSION-BOOT: Do **not** read the book at session boot — it is reference depth, not standing instructions.

p.OPEN-A-CHAPTER-WHEN-A-PHILOSOPHY-QUESTIO: Open a chapter when a philosophy question actually arises; the members' boot snippets carry everything a session needs.

p.books-core-list-lead: The book's core — the four IPC requirements and the memory model:

facts.MEMBER-TWO-PROCESS-MODEL: `two-process-model` — the foundation: human and AI as coprocessors; the human owns coherence; files are the IPC.
facts.MEMBER-WAL: `wal` — the checkpoint file and cold-resume snapshot; session wind-down and resume rituals.
facts.MEMBER-SYNC-FROM-CODE: `sync-from-code` — the sanctioned reverse path when code changed before the spec.
facts.MEMBER-ATOMIC-COMMITS: `git-atomic-commits` — one commit, one idea; Conventional Commits; pushed history is frozen.
facts.MEMBER-ADDRESSABLE-SPECS: `addressable-specs` — `spec://` URIs and stable anchors; correct the agent in twenty tokens.
facts.MEMBER-DECISION-RECORDS: `decision-records` — record decisions with reasons and revisit triggers, at the anchor they govern.
facts.MEMBER-CONFLICT-PROTOCOL: `conflict-protocol` — Human > Spec > Tests > Code; REVIEW markers; the conservative-default uncertainty path.
facts.MEMBER-CAMPAIGN-PLANS: `campaign-plans` — cold-executable plans with phase gates, falsifiable predictions, and an execution ledger.
facts.MEMBER-DISCOVERY-PROMPT: `discovery-prompt` — the structured collaborative-research prompt for open-ended sessions.
facts.MEMBER-ATTRIBUTION-POLICY: `git-attribution-policy` — the deliberate authorship posture (human-authored surface by default).

p.project-practice-list-lead: The project-practice wave — running a project over the long haul:

facts.MEMBER-OPERATING-MODES: `operating-modes` — codeword-triggered postures; red lines that survive every mode.
facts.MEMBER-HEALTH-AUDIT: `health-audit` — the periodic judgment sweep over what the gate cannot see.
facts.MEMBER-MANUAL-TESTS: `manual-tests` — human-runnable walkthroughs for the integration surfaces automation cannot prove.
facts.MEMBER-SECRETS-HYGIENE: `secrets-hygiene` — surface-secrets never printed or persisted; scope discipline; third-party-code consent.
facts.MEMBER-LICENSING: `licensing` — a deliberate licence posture; permissive-only dependencies; the EULA-to-open path.
facts.MEMBER-SPEC-GENRES: `spec-genres` — contract vs lore vs research vs plans; what goes where and who wins.
facts.MEMBER-COMPARATIVE-RESEARCH: `comparative-research` — evergreen competitor studies with two-way gap analysis and roadmap deltas.
facts.MEMBER-MANAGED-BLOCKS: `managed-blocks` — how a tool writes into files it does not own (for tool authors).
facts.MEMBER-QUALIFIED-NAMING: `qualified-naming` — namespaces for package ecosystems (for ecosystem designers).
facts.MEMBER-TOOL-DESIGN-LESSONS: `tool-design-lessons` — paid-for lessons for self-updating tools and package systems.

facts.MEMBER-DEV-RUNTIME-DOCS: `dev-runtime-docs` — the running-notes discipline for a project's development-runtime documents.
facts.MEMBER-WAL-SPECSPACES: `wal-specspaces` — nested projects (specspaces), each carrying its own boot contract, WAL, and cold-resume file.

p.AN-EDITION-IS-A-TESTED-SET: An **edition** is a tested set: the umbrella pins every member exactly, and the umbrella's version is the edition number.

p.MEMBERS-MAY-MOVE-AHEAD-BETWEEN-EDITIONS: Individual members may move ahead on their own lines between editions.
